chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Adhere to the mothers of the children, for in their wombs is the blessing.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of mothers in Islamic tradition according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In the context of al-Kulayni’s *al-Kafi*, this hadith underscores the sanctity of the maternal lineage, linking the physical womb to spiritual *barakah* (blessing). It serves as a foundational principle in Shia jurisprudence and ethics for honoring mothers, particularly within the family structure, reinforcing their central role in transmitting divine grace.
